name: Archive stays archived
author: wizard
description: Archive works like TG style: one click archives a chat, settled or still working, and it stays archived. It no longer pops back while Wizard's list catches up, and the reply to a run that was going when you archived it doesn't bring it back. A chat comes back only when you tap Restore, when you send in it yourself, or when the agent starts a new message there itself (a watch, a schedule); then its row says "Back: <agent> wrote" until you open it.
